description: This file defines a utility class 'ProtectViewWorker' for handling security and access control on web views. It manages rate limiting, tarpit (temporary blocking) for views accessed too frequently, and interacts with entity models to track user view access patterns.

classes.name: ProtectViewWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage access control, rate limiting, and tarpit mechanisms for views based on user login and view access frequency.

methods.name: checkProtectedView
methods.description: Checks if a user is allowed to access a specific view, applying rate limiting and tarpit logic based on recent access history.
